items.title: Three permanence operations for closed subsets proper over a base: for f : X -> Y between S-schemes locally of finite type, images of S-proper closed subsets are S-proper closed when Y is separated over S or f is universally closed, and inverse images of S-proper closed subsets under proper f are S-proper closed.
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter coherent.tex (Cohomology of Schemes)

items.difficulty_reason: All three parts are argued in the span: (1) endow Z with the reduced induced structure and apply the scheme-theoretic-image-proper lemma of the Morphisms chapter; (2) the detailed part: Z'' = f^{-1}(f(Z)) maps universally closed onto f(Z) as a base change of f, so Z -> f(Z) is universally closed by factorization through the closed immersion Z -> Z'', separatedness of f(Z) -> S comes from the image-universally-closed lemma, quasi-compactness descends from the surjection Z -> f(Z), local finite type is a composition statement, and universal closedness of f(Z) -> S follows from that of Z -> S via the image-proper-is-proper lemma; (3) pullback properness by base change plus composition.
